title: One ProjectContext per command: load configuration and dotenv once, propagate configuration errors
description: From kbs-bbf2a6. load_project_configuration has 73 call sites (71 loads for one kanbus list), re-serialises defaults through YAML each call and mutates the process environment via dotenv each time; root discovery, project-dir resolution and overlay config are redone 3 to 6 times per command; malformed configuration is swallowed (if let Ok / .ok() / unwrap_or_default) and changes behaviour. Build one ProjectContext (root, config path, configuration, project dir, overlay config) at command entry in both runtimes and pass it down; load dotenv once at process start; propagate configuration errors, tolerating only file-not-found. Acceptance: configuration loads once per command (counted in a test); malformed configuration fails with a clear error in both runtimes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: PR #550 merged with CI green. One ProjectContext per command in both runtimes: list, show, create and update load configuration exactly once (was 9 to 24 on a small fixture); dotenv loads once at process start; malformed .kanbus.yml fails with 'configuration is not valid YAML' (exit 1) in both runtimes; about 20 swallow sites now propagate configuration errors while realtime publish failures stay warnings. CodeQL: test no longer prints command results; path alert 140 dismissed as a local-CLI false positive.
